VivSoft is seeking a Front-End Developer to support a United States Air Force program focused on secure, modern, and accessible web applications for cybersecurity and vulnerability management. The role builds and enhances user interfaces, integrates enterprise data, and works with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver responsive applications that meet federal security and accessibility requirements.
Computer Software
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Hiring Manager
Archi Nagwani
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain responsive, accessible user interfaces using Vue 3, React, and Angular
Migrate and consolidate functionality across existing front-end applications while maintaining a consistent user experience
Translate wireframes, mockups, and business requirements into production-ready applications
Build dashboards and visualizations using tables, filters, and charts to display security and vulnerability data
Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs and authentication services
Implement OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication and secure token management
Apply front-end security practices, including Content Security Policy (CSP) and cross-site scripting (XSS) prevention
Ensure compliance with Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards
Develop unit and component tests and support automated UI testing
Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, Git workflows, and CI/CD processes

Experience integrating REST APIs using Axios or Fetch

Preferred
Experience with Vite for front-end development and build optimization
Experience with Cypress for end-to-end and component testing
Knowledge of D3.js or other data visualization and charting libraries
Understanding of secure web application development, CSP, and front-end security practices
Familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG accessibility standards
Experience using Docker for local development, testing, and containerized environments
CompTIA Security+ certification or willingness to obtain it to meet DoD 8140 compliance requirements
Previous experience supporting DoD, USAF, or other federal government programs
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and DevSecOps practices
